# Final Implementation Plan — Lightning Wave

## Wave A: Runtime Proof
- Recover or relaunch the production-faithful validation server.
- Open Transcribe at mobile dimensions.
- Prove foundation injection, commerce launcher, Radiance panel, anonymous/sign-in state, stylesheet version, and console/network cleanliness.
- Capture browser evidence and fix only real defects.

## Wave B: Crawlable Acquisition
- Read complete Apps/Games hub and catalog contracts.
- Add deterministic static marketplace projections from canonical catalog data.
- Preserve progressive enhancement and interactive filtering.
- Add semantic fallback inventory and verified links.

## Wave C: SEO Product Graph
- Extend existing server SEO pipeline rather than create parallel metadata authority.
- Generate canonical/OG/JSON-LD/sitemap data from verified public routes/product metadata.
- Keep commerce capability claims conditional on canonical live server actions.

## Wave D: Readiness / Telemetry / Startup
- Add deterministic readiness tests for product IDs, routes, live action handlers, crawlable metadata, source laws, and generated artifacts.
- Add privacy-safe event vocabulary and no-op-safe dispatch for acquisition/commerce outcomes.
- Add cold-start stage timing around the real initialization sequence without weakening startup requirements.

## Wave E: Verification
- Syntax, exact headers, tabs, <120 lines, no minification.
- Existing commerce/Radiance tests plus new catalog/SEO/readiness/telemetry tests.
- Browser mobile/desktop checks, console triage, link checks, and generated artifact drift checks.
- Full touched-file readback and planned-vs-actual delta.
